title: Bavachin ameliorates neuroinflammation and depressive-like behaviors in streptozotocin-induced diabetic mice through the inhibition of PKCdelta.
authors: Zhang, Zhonghong; Sun, Liyan; Guo, Yaping; Zhao, Jie; Li, Jiaqi; Pan, Xiaohong; Li, Zhipeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药补骨脂酚通过抑制PKCdelta/NF-kappaB通路改善糖尿病小鼠神经炎症和抑郁行为，涉及分子对接但核心为小分子-蛋白互作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合建模无关。
abstract: Depression and diabetes are closely linked; however, the pathogenesis of depression associated with diabetes is unclear, and there are no clinically effective antidepressant drugs for diabetic patients with depression. Bavachin is an important active ingredient in Fructus Psoraleae. In this study, we evaluated the anti-neuroinflammatory and antidepressant effects associated with diabetes and the molecular mechanisms of bavachin in a streptozotocin-induced diabetes mouse model. We found that bavachin clearly decreased streptozotocin (STZ)-induced depressive-like behaviors in mice. It was further found that bavachin significantly inhibited microglia activation and the phosphorylation level of PKCdelta and inhibited the activation of the NF-kappaB pathway in vivo and in vitro. Knockdown of PKCdelta with siRNA-PKCdelta partially reversed the inhibitory effect of bavachin on the NF-kappaB pathway and the level of pro-inflammatory factors. We further found that PKCdelta directly bound to bavachin based on molecular docking and pull-down assays. We also found that bavachin improved neuroinflammation-induced neuronal survival and functional impairment and that this effect may be related to activation of the ERK and Akt pathways mediated by the BDNF pathway. Taken together, these data suggested that bavachin, by targeting inhibition PKCdelta to inhibit the NF-kappaB pathway, further reduced the inflammatory response and oxidative stress and subsequently improved diabetic neuronal survival and function and finally ameliorated diabetes-induced depressive-like behaviors in mice. For the first time, we found that bavachin is a potential agent for the treatment of diabetes-associated neuroinflammation and depression and that PKCdelta is a potential target for the treatment of diabetes-associated neuroinflammation, including depression.
abstract_zh: 抑郁症与糖尿病密切相关；然而，糖尿病相关抑郁症的发病机制尚不清楚，且临床上缺乏针对伴有抑郁症的糖尿病患者的有效抗抑郁药物。补骨脂酚 (bavachin) 是补骨脂 (Fructus Psoraleae) 中的重要活性成分。在本研究中，我们在链脲佐菌素诱导的糖尿病小鼠模型中评估了补骨脂酚的抗神经炎症和抗抑郁作用及其分子机制。我们发现，补骨脂酚明显减轻了链脲佐菌素 (STZ) 诱导的小鼠抑郁样行为。进一步研究发现，补骨脂酚在体内和体外均显著抑制了小胶质细胞活化及PKCdelta的磷酸化水平，并抑制了NF-kappaB通路的激活。通过siRNA-PKCdelta敲低PKCdelta，部分逆转了补骨脂酚对NF-kappaB通路及促炎因子水平的抑制作用。我们还基于分子对接和pull-down实验发现，PKCdelta直接与补骨脂酚结合。此外，我们发现补骨脂酚改善了神经炎症诱导的神经元存活和功能损伤，且这一效应可能与BDNF通路介导的ERK和Akt通路激活有关。综合来看，这些数据表明，补骨脂酚通过靶向抑制PKCdelta来抑制NF-kappaB通路，进一步减轻炎症反应和氧化应激，随后改善糖尿病状态下的神经元存活和功能，最终缓解小鼠中糖尿病诱导的抑郁样行为。我们首次发现，补骨脂酚是治疗糖尿病相关神经炎症和抑郁症的潜在药物，且PKCdelta是治疗糖尿病相关神经炎症（包括抑郁症）的潜在靶点。
